cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

mechanism: Misread a raised hand as a family vote, then treat the shared-contribution agreement as protection from cooking duties.
confusable: Not a fully informed shirker: B2 must expose the copied hand gesture as a tea request and A3 must smoothly reinterpret the agreement.
comparison: Family hosting offers a cooperative division of work rather than the hall scene's claimed authority.
seedUse: Retains Christmas hosting/shared effort from the canonical Drive; introduces a copied hand and a concrete turkey/clearing bargain.
